restaurant_name: พัทยาเฉพาะทาง-สาขาเทพประสิทธิ์ (คลินิกหมอประทีป)
text: Came here looking for a gynecologist without appointment. The place is small and very busy but everyone is friendly. Although the staff spoke little English, the gynecologist spoke English really well. I came around 16.40 and waited 40min for my turn. I had the consult in the office and was brought to a little back room for examination. The process was efficient and comfortable. I had a really good experience     and it was really affordable.

restaurant_name: พัทยาเฉพาะทาง-สาขาเทพประสิทธิ์ (คลินิกหมอประทีป)
text: The ultrasound was performed by a male doctor. It was the first time I'd ever had a test that was incredibly painful, and I wouldn't risk having the same doctor do it again. They didn't give me the results. When I asked when and how I could get the results, they were very surprised and went to check with the doctor. They said I'd have to redo the test because the doctor hadn't saved the images. I asked for the descriptions without the images, but they didn't give me those either. Why even bother performing the test if you don't provide a report? The girl who registers patients is very attentive and polite, and I appreciate her service.

restaurant_name: พัทยาเฉพาะทาง-สาขาเทพประสิทธิ์ (คลินิกหมอประทีป)
text:
A small, honest, and very important clinic for anyone dealing with women's issues. They focus exclusively on gynecology and pregnancy—nothing else. They do 4D ultrasounds, check your cycle, prescribe contraception, help with missed periods, provide pregnancy care, and check for infections.

From personal experience: a woman had a menstrual problem—her period wouldn't finish. We came without an appointment, the doctor examined her, and gave her some pills. A couple of days later, everything returned to normal. No unnecessary words, just to the point.

Since this is the only clinic in Pattaya that truly cares about women's health, it's often full. I recommend arriving early.

text: Looking for an MFM test? Came here because of the reviews. The doctor was very thorough and spoke Chinese with my partner. He communicated well with me. The service was good. If I'm pregnant with my second child, I'd like to come here. I already had my first child elsewhere. The cost was 2,000 baht. Next time, I'll come here for an ultrasound. I'll wait until my pregnancy is more advanced. 100/100. I recommend coming here to all moms. The doctor is at the clinic on Fridays from 4:30 PM until the clinic closes. #DrSamut

text:

I was very impressed with the doctor. From start to finish of removing my contraceptive implant, the doctor was very polite, friendly, and kept chatting with me throughout the process. This helped me relax and feel comfortable, even though I was a little anxious.

During the procedure, the doctor was very gentle; I barely felt any pain. If I were to rate the pain level, it would be 0/10! The doctor explained every step and gave detailed advice after removal. They answered all my questions patiently, making me feel confident and well cared for.

Thank you so much, doctor, for your warm and professional care. It was a much better experience than I expected. If anyone is worried about removing their contraceptive implant, I highly recommend this doctor. You'll feel comfortable from beginning to end. ❤️
